prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的答案。
text: The students _____ projects won awards were invited to the stage.

wrong.who: who 後面要接動詞當主詞；這裡後面是名詞 projects，表示「他們的專題」，要用 whose。
wrong.which: which 用來指物，先行詞 the students 是人，而且要表示所屬關係。

why: whose + 名詞表示所屬，whose projects 就是「那些學生的專題」。
tip: whose 後面接名詞，表示所屬。
say: The students whose projects won awards were invited to the stage.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的答案。
text: This is the house _____ my grandfather was born.

wrong.which: which 在子句中需要當主詞或受詞，但 my grandfather was born 後面不缺名詞，要用表示地點的 where。
wrong.who: who 指人，先行詞 the house 是地點，不適用。

why: 先行詞是地點，子句內不缺名詞成分，用關係副詞 where。
tip: 地點先行詞，子句完整：用 where。
say: This is the house where my grandfather was born.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的答案。
text: The reason _____ he left early is still unknown.

wrong.which: which 在子句中必須當主詞或受詞，但 he left early 已完整，要用關係副詞 why。
wrong.when: when 的先行詞是時間，the reason 是理由，要用 why。

why: 先行詞是 reason 時，關係副詞用 why，表示原因。
say: The reason why he left early is still unknown.

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: My sister, who lives in Tainan, is a nurse.
My sister, that lives in Tainan, is a nurse.
My sister, which lives in Tainan, is a nurse.
answer: My sister, who lives in Tainan, is a nurse.

wrong.My sister, that lives in Tainan, is a nu: 有逗號的補充說明子句不能用 that，要用 who。
wrong.My sister, which lives in Tainan, is a n: which 指物，my sister 是人，要用 who。

why: 非限定子句前面有逗號，指人用 who，不用 that。
say: My sister, who lives in Tainan, is a nurse.

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: All that I want is a quiet room.
All what I want is a quiet room.
All which I want is a quiet room.
answer: All that I want is a quiet room.

what 本身已包含先行詞，不能接在 all 後面，要用 that。
先行詞是 all、everything 等不定代名詞時，習慣用 that，不用 which。

why: 先行詞是 all、everything、nothing 時，關係代名詞通常用 that。
say: All that I want is a quiet room.

prompt: “The report, which was published last week, has been criticized.” 是什麼意思？
options: 這份報告上週已發表，而且受到批評。
只有上週發表的版本受到批評，其他版本沒有。
報告在上週批評了別人。
answer: 這份報告上週已發表，而且受到批評。

wrong.只有上週發表的版本受到批評，其他版本沒有。: 有逗號的子句只是補充說明，不是用來區分不同版本。
wrong.報告在上週批評了別人。: has been criticized 是被批評，不是報告批評別人。

why: 逗號中間的關係子句是補充資訊，主句是這份報告受到批評。
tip: 逗號子句是補充，不是限定範圍。
say: The report, which was published last week, has been criticized.

prompt: “The employees who worked overtime received a bonus.” 是什麼意思？
options: 只有加班的員工得到獎金。
所有員工都加班並得到獎金。
answer: 只有加班的員工得到獎金。

wrong.所有員工都加班並得到獎金。: 沒有逗號的關係子句是限定，用來區分「加班的那些」員工。
wrong.獎金讓所有員工加班。: 句子是加班的人得到獎金，順序是先加班再得獎金。

why: 沒有逗號的 who 子句限定範圍，指出哪一些員工。
say: The employees who worked overtime received a bonus.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的答案。
text: He failed the test, _____ surprised no one.

wrong.that: 補充說明整個前句的子句，要用 which，不用 that。
wrong.what: what 不能指前面的整句內容，要用 which。

why: which 可以代替整個前面的句子，補充說明結果。
tip: 逗號後 which 可指整句話。
say: He failed the test, which surprised no one.

prompt: 你想描述一座城市：「台北是一座古老寺廟與現代大樓並存的城市。」哪一句最自然？
options: Taipei is a city where old temples and modern towers stand side by side.
Taipei is a city which old temples and modern towers stand side by side.
Taipei is a city who old temples and modern towers stand side by side.
answer: Taipei is a city where old temples and modern towers stand side by side.

wrong.Taipei is a city which old temples and m: which 在子句中要當主詞或受詞；這裡子句已經完整，需要表示地點的 where。
wrong.Taipei is a city who old temples and mod: who 指人，a city 是地點。

why: 先行詞是地點，子句完整，用 where。
say: Taipei is a city where old temples and modern towers stand side by side.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的答案。
text: The conference at _____ the results were announced was broadcast live.

wrong.where: 介系詞 at 後面不能再加 where，at which 才是正確搭配。
wrong.that: 關係代名詞 that 不能直接接在介系詞後面。

why: 介系詞 + 關係代名詞，只能用 whom / which，不能用 that。
tip: 介系詞後面用 which / whom。
say: The conference at which the results were announced was broadcast live.

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: The scientist whose theory changed physics won the prize.
The scientist who's theory changed physics won the prize.
The scientist whom theory changed physics won the prize.
answer: The scientist whose theory changed physics won the prize.

wrong.The scientist who's theory changed physi: who's 是 who is 的縮寫，所屬關係要用 whose。
wrong.The scientist whom theory changed physic: whom 是受格，不能表示所屬；要用 whose 加名詞。

why: 表示「他的理論」，用 whose theory。
tip: who's = who is；whose 表示所屬。
say: The scientist whose theory changed physics won the prize.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的答案。
text: Anyone _____ wants to join the trip should sign up by Friday.

wrong.whom: whom 是受格；這裡 wants 前面缺主詞，要用 who。

why: 先行詞是人，在子句中當主詞，用 who。
say: Anyone who wants to join the trip should sign up by Friday.
